findings.title: Goal execution check errors crash at the implementation/coordinator boundary
findings.detail: do_run_codex_turns/9 can now return {:error, {:goal_execution_check_failed, reason}}, but continue_after_implementation/3 matches only :ok and {:paused, budget}. A fetch, inherit, gateway-contract, or execution-check failure therefore raises CaseClauseError instead of returning the structured error to the orchestrator for normal retry and audit handling.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit {:error, reason} branch that returns the error unchanged, and cover the GoalExecution failure path through continue_after_implementation_for_test/3.

summary: Changes requested: exact local and remote bos/issue-53 HEADs match and exact-commit validations pass, but the newly reachable Goal authorization error path is not handled at the implementation-stage boundary and crashes with CaseClauseError.
